reason: Adds chat image upload and paste support, using either a configured DashScope vision model or Windows offline OCR to describe images and prepend the description to outgoing messages.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中上传或粘贴图片，并通过百炼视觉模型或 Windows 离线 OCR 将图片内容转述后注入发送消息。
summaries.en: Upload or paste images in the chat input and use a configured DashScope vision model or Windows offline OCR to describe them before adding the description to the outgoing message.

capabilities: Accepts pasted or uploaded images in the chat interface
Sends images to a configured DashScope vision model for description
Runs Windows offline OCR through a PowerShell subprocess
Injects the resulting image description into outgoing chat messages
